title: On the Evolution of (Hateful) Memes by Means of Multimodal Contrastive Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Clustering multimodal CLIP embeddings of 4chan image-text pairs, annotating clusters, and measuring identity attack scores using Perspective API and Rewire API, with an in-depth case study analyzing the visual and linguistic evolution of the antisemitic 'Happy Merchant' meme.

Identifying hateful communities targeting specific racial groups (e.g., Africans) by clustering 4chan posts via DBSCAN, automatically annotating them with KeyBERT, and scoring the text for identity attacks.

Extracting Geo-Political Entities (GPE) and Nationalities (NORP) using Named Entity Recognition and leveraging CLIP's visual-linguistic semantic regularities to find meme variants targeting specific countries and immigrants/refugees.

Using NLP named entity extraction and algebraic operations on CLIP embeddings to identify and perform temporal analysis on hateful meme variants fused with specific political figures and organizations.
Detecting identity attacks against religious groups (e.g., Muslims) by calculating the fraction of hateful posts within image-text clusters using Perspective API's identity attack metric.
